name: Youth Services, Workforce Development Board of Contra Costa County
org: Workforce Development Board of Contra Costa County
what_you_do: Get help to finish school, find a job or start a career. Help can include a case manager, job training, work, a mentor and help with school.
who_can_apply: Youth and young adults ages 16 to 24 who have barriers to finishing school, finding a job or starting a career. The page asks if you have a disability, are low income, or have been in the justice system. Those answers can get you Priority of Service.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page. The page lists work experience as one kind of help.
deadline_text: The board offers services all year. No deadline is stated.
how_to_apply: Register on CalJOBS, the state job site linked on the page. Then contact the board at the email or phone number on its site. Ask about youth services.
notes: The board office is at 4071 Port Chicago Highway, Suite 200, Concord. The page lists wdb@ehsd.cccounty.us and (925) 655-3800. The Mt. Diablo school district runs a WIOA youth program for Central County and Bay Point. Its page points East and West County youth to the County Office of Education. See those cards.
